overview.overview: The Everest Base Camp Trek is the ultimate Himalayan adventure, taking trekkers to the base of the world's highest mountain at 5,364m. This classic 14-day trek traverses the Khumbu region through ancient Sherpa villages, crosses high suspension bridges over the Dudh Koshi River, passes through Sagarmatha National Park (UNESCO World Heritage Site), and culminates at the South Base Camp of Mount Everest. The trek offers unparalleled views of Everest, Lhotse, Nuptse, and Makalu, with the option to hike Kala Patthar (5,545m) for the best Everest viewpoint.

faq.question: What is the maximum altitude on EBC Trek?
faq.answer: 5,364 meters (17,598 feet) at Everest Base Camp. Kala Patthar at 5,545m is highest point trekkers climb

faq.question: How many days does EBC Trek take?
faq.answer: 14 days standard, including 2 acclimatization days. Minimum 12 days possible

faq.question: What permits are required for EBC Trek?
faq.answer: Sagarmatha National Park Permit (NPR 3,000) and Khumbu Pasang Lhamu Rural Municipality Permit (NPR 3,000). TIMS NOT required

faq.question: Is EBC Trek difficult?
faq.answer: Moderate to Difficult. High altitude (5,545m) is main challenge. Requires good fitness, 5-8 hours walking daily

faq.question: What is the total distance of EBC Trek?
faq.answer: 130-140 km round trip from Lukla

faq.question: Can I get altitude sickness on EBC Trek?
faq.answer: Yes, high risk above 3,000m. Maximum 5,545m - acclimatization days essential, descent critical if symptoms worsen

faq.question: When is the best time for EBC Trek?
faq.answer: Autumn (September-November) and Spring (March-May) - best visibility, stable weather

faq.question: Do I need a guide for EBC Trek?
faq.answer: Not mandatory but highly recommended for safety, navigation, and emergency support

faq.question: How much does EBC Trek cost?
faq.answer: $1,000-2,500 excluding international flights, depending on service level

faq.question: Are there tea houses on EBC Trek?
faq.answer: Yes, 50-60 tea houses throughout route with basic rooms and meals

faq.question: Is meat available on EBC Trek?
faq.answer: Only below Tengboche (3,860m). Above that, only vegetarian food due to no refrigeration

faq.question: Can I drink tap water on EBC Trek?
faq.answer: No - must boil, purify with tablets, or UV sterilizer. Buy boiled water (USD 2-4/liter)

faq.question: Is Wi-Fi available on EBC Trek?
faq.answer: Yes via Everest Link up to Lobuche (fee NPR 300-500). No Wi-Fi above, weather dependent

faq.question: How much does helicopter evacuation cost?
faq.answer: $3,000-6,000 USD. Essential to have insurance covering 6,000m+ altitude evacuation

faq.question: What should I pack for EBC Trek?
faq.answer: Down jacket, warm layers, good boots, rain gear, water purification, first aid kit, pulse oximeter, headlamp, trekking poles

faq.question: Do I need trekking poles?
faq.answer: Essential for steep descents, glacier terrain, and stability at high altitude

faq.question: Can I charge my phone on EBC Trek?
faq.answer: Yes, electricity available throughout (fee $2-5/device), mostly solar/hydro power

faq.question: Are hot showers available on EBC Trek?
faq.answer: Yes below 3,500m (fee NPR 300-500). Limited above, cold water only above 4,500m

faq.question: What mountains can I see from EBC?
faq.answer: Lhotse (8,516m), Nuptse (7,861m), Khumbu Icefall. Everest visible from nearby

faq.question: What mountains can I see from Kala Patthar?
faq.answer: Full Everest (8,848m), Lhotse, Nuptse, Pumori - best sunrise viewpoint in world

faq.question: Is EBC Trek safer than Annapurna Base Camp?
faq.answer: No - max altitude 5,545m vs 4,130m, higher altitude sickness risk. More challenging

faq.question: Can I do EBC Trek in winter?
faq.answer: Yes but very cold (-15°C to -25°C at EBC), possible snow. Less crowded, clear views

faq.question: How do I get to Lukla from Kathmandu?
faq.answer: 25-30 min flight (USD 225). Weather dependent. Alternative: Ramechhap flight more reliable

faq.question: What is the difference between EBC and Kala Patthar?
faq.answer: EBC (5,364m) is climbing base camp. Kala Patthar (5,545m) is viewpoint with best Everest panorama

faq.question: Are there monkeys on EBC Trek?
faq.answer: No monkeys. Rare wildlife includes Himalayan thar, snow leopard (extremely rare sightings)

faq.question: Can I see rhododendrons on EBC Trek?
faq.answer: Yes, rhododendron forests 3,000-4,000m, bloom in spring (March-May)

faq.question: Is there a health clinic on EBC Trek?
faq.answer: HRA clinic at Pheriche (4,243m) - altitude medicine, pulse oximetry. EBC emergency tent (spring season only)

faq.question: What emergency number for trekking in Nepal?
faq.answer: Police 100, Tourist Police 1144, Everest Rescue +977 9801360911, Heli On Call +977 9851017030

faq.question: Can I trek EBC without prior experience?
faq.answer: Yes, no technical climbing needed. Good physical fitness essential, 5-8 hours daily walking, high altitude challenge

faq.question: What is the altitude of Namche Bazaar?
faq.answer: 3,440 meters (11,286 feet)

faq.question: What is the altitude of Gorakshep?
faq.answer: 5,140 meters (16,863 feet)

faq.question: Is EBC Trek suitable for beginners?
faq.answer: Challenging for beginners due to extreme altitude. Good fitness, preparation, and guide recommended

faq.question: How many liters of water should I drink daily?
faq.answer: 3-4 liters to prevent dehydration and altitude sickness

faq.question: Can I bring my own tent for EBC Trek?
faq.answer: Not necessary - tea houses available everywhere. Camping only for special group arrangements

faq.question: What toilet facilities are on EBC Trek?
faq.answer: Western-style below, squat toilets above. Shared facilities, sanitation decent but basic above 4,000m

faq.question: Is Dal Bhat free on EBC Trek?
faq.answer: Often unlimited at many tea houses - traditional 'food for infinity'. Worth it for energy

faq.question: Can I see snow leopards on EBC Trek?
faq.answer: Extremely rare - snow leopards inhabit area but sightings virtually impossible for trekkers

faq.question: What is the best footwear for EBC Trek?
faq.answer: Sturdy waterproof trekking boots with ankle support, good grip, considered for glacier terrain

faq.question: Do I need sun protection on EBC Trek?
faq.answer: Essential - extreme UV at high altitude. Sunscreen SPF 50+, sunglasses (category 4), hat mandatory

faq.question: Can I use credit cards on EBC Trek?
faq.answer: No cash only. Carry NPR (Nepali Rupees) - ATMs only in Kathmandu

faq.question: What is the walking time daily on EBC Trek?
faq.answer: Average 5-8 hours, 8-16 km per day depending on section

faq.question: Is EBC Trek crowded?
faq.answer: Popular trek. Spring and autumn busiest. Winter less crowded but colder

faq.question: Can I do EBC Trek solo?
faq.answer: Not recommended - guide essential for safety at extreme altitude, navigation, emergency support

faq.question: What insurance do I need for EBC Trek?
faq.answer: Must cover high-altitude trekking to 6,000m+ and helicopter evacuation ($3,000-6,000)

faq.question: Is there mobile network on EBC Trek?
faq.answer: Yes, NTC coverage up to Lobuche. No network above, weather dependent

faq.question: What is the temperature at EBC in winter?
faq.answer: -15°C to -25°C at night, can drop to -30°C. Daytime -5°C to 5°C

faq.question: Can I shower at EBC/Gorakshep?
faq.answer: No hot showers at Gorakshep. Cold water only, not recommended due to extreme cold

faq.question: What is the lowest point on EBC Trek?
faq.answer: Phakding at 2,610 meters (8,563 feet)

faq.question: How steep is the climb to Kala Patthar?
faq.answer: From Gorakshep, 400m ascent in 1.5-2 hours. Steep but manageable for most

faq.question: Can I see sunrise from EBC?
faq.answer: Yes but Kala Patthar is better sunrise viewpoint. Sunrise from EBC foggy often

faq.question: Do I need a headlamp for EBC Trek?
faq.answer: Essential - early sunrise hikes, evening movement, no electricity after certain hours

faq.question: What is the food cost on EBC Trek?
faq.answer: $30-50/day average. Increases dramatically with altitude (4x at EBC vs Lukla)

faq.question: Can babies/children do EBC Trek?
faq.answer: Not recommended below 12-14 years. Altitude 5,545m dangerous for young children
